Activates Demonic True Eclipse until own HP reaches 20%. When used during Demonic True Eclipse: 70000% Dark DMG (MAG). For 20s, consume 2%/s of own max HP and increase Allies' Arts by 7/s.
Note: This unit's Arts Gen is Type B and will not stack with other Type B Arts Gen.
